 About the Role (Job Summary): 

 The Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations is responsible for shaping and executing the organization's digital platform and marketing technology strategy. This leader oversees digital products, marketing platforms, operational processes, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performing digital experiences that support business growth and customer engagement.

 This role combines strategic leadership, digital product management, marketing technology (MarTech) expertise, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Technology, Digital Product, and Business leaders to optimize platforms, improve operational effectiveness, and advance digital transformation initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 The Transformation Driver: You have demonstrated experience successfully driving massive architectural or engineering operating-model shifts within an organization.

 The Operations Sentinel: You possess a profound understanding of reliability, telemetry, security, and operational excellence in massive, high-stakes production systems.

 The Strategic Diplomat: You wield excellent communication and influence skills, capable of partnering flawlessly with Product Management, Architecture, and C-suite stakeholders.

 The Pragmatic Visionary: You excel at systems thinking—perfectly balancing the need for long-term architectural integrity with the reality of pragmatic, incremental delivery.

 Your Rewards & Well-being: 
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

 Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. 
 PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.
 To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Who We Are 

 At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we’re the team behind Money Mart—Canada’s largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

 From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

 At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

 We’ve Got You Covered 

 Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

 Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

 Retirement Plans: Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you’re set for the long haul.

 Hybrid Work Environment: Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

 Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 What You’ll Bring 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.

 Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

 Committed to Equal Opportunity: 

 MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.
  

 About MFSG – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

 At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

 This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities. 

 We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

 Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

 Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor

 Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC 2, cloud control frameworks, and privacy control frameworks

Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform. 

 As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows.

 Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.

 Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.

 Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.

 Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.

 Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.

 Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.

 Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

 Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.

 Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.

The base pay range for this role is $121,000 - $170,000. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
 
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 
 
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
 
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
 
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
 
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.


Position Summary 
Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Financial Planning & Analysis, the Director, Commercial FP&A will own two of the highest-priority pillars in PCC's commercial finance agenda: Commercial Deal Operational Excellence and Contribution Margin Expansion. This is a senior leadership role with direct executive exposure — partnering with GTM, Revenue Operations, Corporate Strategy, and Partnerships leadership to shape the commercial decisions that drive ARR growth and contribution margin performance. The ideal candidate is a commercially-minded finance leader who has built and led high-performing teams, owned complex cross-functional mandates, and is ready to pioneer the AI transformation of a best-in-class Commercial FP&A function.

 The role is for Global Data Center engineering lead managing a high performing team of senior engineers responsible for all the networking technology running in the RBC’s global data centers including our cloud presence in Azure and AWS.

 We are in 32 countries with a global network spanning Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia PAC and Europe. We own, manage and operate a very large and complex interconnected network from the fiber in the ground to every technology involved in delivering a service to our clients. We also manage two complex content delivery networks, Akamai and Cloudflare that serves RBC’s 13 million banking customers.

 Core data center technologies - Cisco Nexus including ACI and Arista

 Manage the implementation of multiple concurrent initiatives of varying complexity in a time efficient manner.  Monitor and control activities according to plan.

jobs.title: Director, DevOps Insights
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 RBC's DevOps team owns the data behind how our engineers work: the telemetry from every tool in the software development lifecycle, from source control and CI/CD through to the AI coding assistants developers now use every day. As Director, DevOps Insights, you'll lead the data engineering and data science team that turns this telemetry into answers senior and executive leadership act on. What is AI adoption costing us, what is it returning, where is developer productivity improving, and where is it stuck? You'll own the Tokenomics model that forecasts AI spend across engineering and the productivity measurement that shows whether the investment is paying off. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who uses AI coding agents daily and wants to lead a team that does the same

 What will you do? 

 Lead and grow the team 
 Manage, coach and develop a team of data engineers and data scientists, setting clear goals and creating growth paths for each person
 Build a team culture where AI agents are part of everyday engineering and analysis work, and where output quality is measured
 Prioritize the team's work against the highest-value questions from leadership, Finance and engineering teams

 Own the developer data platform 
 Set the roadmap for ingesting, modelling and serving telemetry from the tools developers use: source control, CI/CD, work tracking, IDEs, AI coding assistants and cloud platforms
 Direct the engineering of pipelines on Snowflake, Airflow and Python, with the reliability and data quality standards a bank requires
 Establish the metrics definitions (DORA, SPACE and RBC-specific measures) used across RBC

 Deliver Tokenomics and productivity insights 
 Own the cost attribution and forecasting model for AI tooling usage across engineering, and report it to executive leadership and Finance
 Produce the analysis that shapes AI usage policy and provides input to vendor negotiations
 Quantify developer productivity and the benefits of AI adoption, and present findings that lead to decisions
 Build self-serve reporting so teams and leaders can answer routine questions without the team in the loop

 Apply AI to the work 
 Use AI coding agents and analytical tools in the team's own pipelines, analysis and reporting, and set the standard for how they're used
 Evaluate model cost and quality trade-offs when applying LLMs to insights problems

 Partner across the bank 
 Work with Finance on spend forecasting and budget planning for AI and developer tooling
 Partner with platform owners and engineering leaders to close data gaps and validate findings
 Present to senior and executive audiences with clear recommendations

 What do you need to succeed 
 Must Have 
 Minimum 10+ years in data engineering, data science or software development, with 3+ years in director-level or equivalent leadership roles
 People management experience leading data engineers and/or data scientists, with a record of coaching and growing individuals
 Daily hands-on use of AI coding agents in your own work, and the ability to discuss in detail how you use them, where they fail and how you check their output
 Strong data engineering background: Python, SQL, Snowflake, Airflow and cloud data platforms
 Experience turning operational telemetry into metrics and insights for senior audiences; familiarity with DORA, SPACE or comparable frameworks
 Experience with cost analysis or forecasting of technology spend, presented to executives and finance partners
 Ability to prioritize competing demands against a small team's capacity and to influence without direct authority

 Nice to have 
 Shipped an LLM-based capability into production
 Led AI adoption across an engineering or analytics team and measured its results
 Experience shaping usage policy or contributing to vendor negotiations for developer or AI tooling
 Data science depth: statistical analysis, experimentation and forecasting models

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity?   
 At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.
 As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

 What will you do?   

 Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
 Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
 Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
 Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
 Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
 Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
 Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must Have 
 10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
 Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
 Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
 Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
 Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
 Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

 Nice to Have   
 Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
 Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
 Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
 Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 As part of the Group Risk Management team, the Associate Director, Global Risk Analytics is responsible for the conceptual design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the mathematical models used for the measurement and capitalization of the market risk of RBC's trading portfolio.

 This includes ensuring that the model's underlying methodologies are appropriate and that they are implemented with integrity, to facilitate the effective management of the bank's market risk and capital adequacy assessment for CCAR scenarios under the FRTB framework. 

 What will you do? 
 Work with model users to understand their business requirements.
 Conduct research, review regulatory requirements and consult with industry stakeholders to evaluate best practices for modeling.
 Make recommendations on model methodologies, and develop technical implementation, either for production usage or to serve as a prototype for benchmark testing.
 Provide business requirements with technical implementation details and user acceptance criteria to technology teams for production deployment, and validate implementation using independently developed benchmark models.
 Document model methodologies, implementation details and testing results, and work with internal validation to facilitate their approval of the models.
 Develop tools to assess and monitor model performance, including assumptions and limitations, on an ongoing basis for reporting to the various model monitoring governance committees.
 Investigate and remediate modeling issues identified through ongoing monitoring or by internal validation.
 Re-assessment and testing of models, including assumptions and limitations and benchmarking against alternative models, and documentation of the results in models whitepapers and annual assessments for review by internal validation.

 What do you need to succeed? 

 Must Have: 
 Broad knowledge of traded products across various asset classes, and knowledge of regulatory & internal risk management requirements for market risk and CCAR
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills
 Excellent programming skills (e.g., Python, MatLab)
 Data management and analysis skills (SQL and Excel required)
 Ability to work collaboratively to achieve team goals
 Agility to adapt to changing circumstances in a dynamic environment
 Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, especially in the explanation of complex modeling concepts to senior management and regulators

 Masters in Financial Engineering, or a degree in another quantitative subject such as physics, statistics, mathematics or mathematical finance and/or a relevant professional qualification, with concentration in quantitative methods and/or finance.

jobs.title: Senior Director, ALM Research & Analytics
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 Lead RBC Corporate Treasury's quantitative ALM methodology development, modelling, research and analytics, focusing on interest rate risk measurement and management. Lead development of behavioral and market risk models, supporting pricing and risk measurement for non-trading on-balance sheet products, mortgage and loan commitments, securitization, and term funding. Interest rate risk represents the bank’s largest structural book market risk, with effective measurement and management critical for shareholder value preservation. Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 As part of the Group Risk Management team, the Director, Counterparty Credit Risk Analytics leads a team which is responsible for the conceptual design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the mathematical models used for the measurement and capitalization of the counterparty credit risk of RBC's derivative and SFT portfolio. This includes ensuring that the model's underlying methodologies are appropriate and that they are implemented with integrity, to facilitate the effective management of the bank's CCR. 

 What will you do? 
 Work with model users to understand their business requirements.

 Conduct research, review regulatory requirements and consult with industry stakeholders to evaluate best practices for modeling.

 Make recommendations on model methodologies, and develop technical implementation, either for production usage or to serve as a prototype for benchmark testing.

 Provide business requirements with technical implementation details and user acceptance criteria to technology teams for production deployment, and validate implementation using independently developed benchmark models.

 Document model methodologies, implementation details and testing results, and work with internal validation to facilitate their approval of the models.

 Develop tools to assess and monitor model performance, including assumptions and limitations, on an ongoing basis for reporting to the various model monitoring governance committees.

 Investigate and remediate modeling issues identified through regular re-reviews, ongoing monitoring or by internal validation.

 Recalibrate models on a regular basis.

 Re-assessment and testing of models, including assumptions and limitations and benchmarking against alternative models, and documentation of the results in models whitepapers and annual assessments for review by internal validation.

 What do you need to succeed? 

 Must Have: 
 Broad knowledge of traded products across various asset classes.

 Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry best practices for the measurement and management of counterparty credit risk.

 Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

 Excellent programming skills (e.g., Python).

jobs.description:
Job Description 

 Senior Director, AI Business Enablement 

 What's the opportunity? 
 We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.
 You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
 Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
 AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
 Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
 Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
 Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
 Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
 Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

 You're our ideal candidate if you: 
 Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
 Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
 Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
 Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
 Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
 Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
 Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
 Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

 What's in it for you: 
 Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
 Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

 About the AI Group: 
 RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

 What is the opportunity? 
 A finance professional with strong financial and presentation acumen will serve as a key source of comprehensive analysis of RBC's capital position—actual and forecasted—supporting senior executives including the CFO, Treasurer, ALCO, GE, and the Board. This role leverages automation and AI to streamline processes, drive operational efficiency, and deliver actionable capital recommendations that inform strategic decision-making across the organization. 

 What will you do? 
 Provide comprehensive quantitative and qualitative analysis of RBC's regulatory capital position (CET1, Tier1, Total Capital, Leverage, TLAC, TLAC Leverage ratio) and deliver actionable recommendations to senior management 
 Identify high-impact opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to enhance forecasting accuracy, automate manual analyses, and accelerate capital planning, sensitivities, and monitoring processes 
 Assess compliance with regulatory capital requirements, internal risk appetite thresholds, and Board-approved limits; identify gaps and escalate risks proactively 
 Perform capital adequacy assessments and forward-looking capital trends; communicate results through compelling visual presentations and executive summaries 
 Lead quantitative and qualitative scenario analysis of capital implications arising from strategic projects, business initiatives, accounting changes, regulatory updates, and structured transactions 
 Collaborate with business units and subject matter experts to validate assumptions and ensure analytical rigor of capital forecasts 
 Lead development and execution of RBC's Capital Plan and Strategic Outlook; communicate capital assumptions, constraints, and implications across the organization 
 Communicate limit compliance status, capital trends, and forward-looking risks through dashboards and presentations that enable informed governance and decision-making 
 Benchmark RBC's capital and performance profiles against peers to inform strategic direction 

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must-have: 
 Pertinent university degree or equivalent 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in finance and/or regulatory capital 
 Excellent analytical and research skills 
 Advanced proficiency in database management, spreadsheet design, and presentation development 
 Strong written and oral communication 
 Proven ability to work across business platforms and collaborate with senior professionals 

 Nice-to-have: 
 Graduate university degree, CPA, CFA, or equivalent experience 
 Modelling capability to assess transaction scenarios 
 Experience with AI transformation and advanced analytics integration 

 What’s in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
 Work in an agile, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
 The opportunity to interface with senior level executives from many different parts of the organization

jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 An exciting opportunity to join Enterprise Controller (Wholesale Finance) team. The Associate Director, Commercial Banking Financial Control, will act as the subject matter expert and key point of contact for the Commercial Banking business in Canada, with the objective of delivering timely, accurate and reliable financial information. The people manager will support the internal and external reporting, disclosure requirements and control framework, as well as seek opportunities to streamline existing processes and lead ad-hoc projects, while liaising and collaborating with various stakeholders across the Enterprise.

 What will you do? 
 Ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial and regulatory reporting for supported business lines by reviewing monthly GL data, financial results and variances to ensure accuracy, including monitoring of allocations and other intergroup activities.
 Responsible to ensure new products and new transactions are appropriately captured in RBC financial reporting systems, and that appropriate accounting methodologies are applied. In particular, prepare analyses that take into account IFRS accounting implications and external and internal reporting requirements including MD&A, B/S, P&L, note disclosures & supplemental formats.
 Review the monthly Global Attestation review program to ensure proper financial controls supporting external financial results are in place.  Ensure that global policies and procedures are adhered to by all stakeholders including monitoring of allocations and other intergroup activities.
 Subject matter expert for deposits and lending products accounting issues. Maintain technical knowledge and ensure Financial Control, Product Control, and Business teams are kept abreast of all new accounting developments.
 Contribute and represent Finance function on various IT system projects/initiatives.
 Ensure SOX and RBC EUDA documentation compliance and completeness including new controls/processes.
 Participate in ad-hoc projects as directed by Director, Commercial Banking Financial Control.

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must-have 
 CPA designation or equivalent. This mandate is highly dependent on using analytical and financial reporting skills commonly associated with accounting designations.
 Knowledge of relevant financial and regulatory accounting standards, especially IFRS 9.
 Strong communication, interpersonal and collaboration skills are considered necessary for the success of this role.
 Acute attention to detail and excellent analytical thinking
 Strong leadership, people management, and team building skills.
 Strong interpersonal skills, due to frequent interaction with Front Office Senior Management, with the ability to explain complex accounting issues in a concise and meaningful manner.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Product Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 Join our U.S. Technology Strategy and Architecture team as Director, Technology Product Strategy, where you will play a key role in supporting the development and execution of technology strategy across RBC’s U.S. organization.
 Working closely with U.S. Technology Strategy & Architecture leadership, business lines, technology teams, and enterprise architecture, you will help shape the strategic direction of the U.S. technology organization. You will analyze the technology landscape, support strategic planning and investment decisions, and work across business and technology teams to advance key priorities.
 This role provides broad exposure across the U.S. technology organization and an opportunity to work on some of its most important strategic questions. You will combine structured problem solving, technology knowledge, stakeholder management, and executive communication to support senior leaders in making informed technology decisions and advancing the U.S. technology agenda.

 What will you do? 
 Support target-state strategy development:  Partner with Technology Strategy & Architecture leadership to develop and maintain forward-looking U.S. technology strategy and, where required, business-line technology strategies. Gather inputs, assess strategic alternatives, and translate direction into clear target-state objectives, principles, KPIs, and priorities.
 Maintain a view of the technology estate:  Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of the U.S. technology landscape, bringing together information on applications, platforms, infrastructure, capabilities, dependencies, and investments to support strategic planning and decision-making.
 Conduct strategic analyses:  Perform structured, point-in-time analyses of technology opportunities, challenges, and strategic questions. Synthesize quantitative and qualitative information, evaluate alternatives, and develop recommendations for leadership consideration.
 Support strategic alignment:  Work with business and technology stakeholders to assess the alignment of major initiatives, programs, and investments with U.S. technology strategy and enterprise priorities. Identify potential gaps or areas of misalignment and support development of appropriate actions.
 Support roadmap and funding decisions:  Develop analyses and decision materials that help leadership evaluate technology roadmaps, investment priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, and funding requirements.
 Support architecture governance and control:  Partner with Enterprise Architecture and technology teams to facilitate architecture governance activities, track strategic and architectural decisions, identify areas requiring escalation, and support alignment with established architecture principles and target states.
 Coordinate strategic planning activities:  Support recurring strategy, roadmap, portfolio, and governance processes across the U.S. technology organization, ensuring stakeholders have the information and analysis required to make timely decisions.
 Develop executive-level materials:  Translate complex technology topics into concise presentations, recommendations, business cases, and decision materials for senior technology and business leadership.
 Monitor strategic progress:  Develop and maintain KPIs, KRIs, and other measures that provide visibility into progress against technology strategies, roadmaps, strategic initiatives, and architectural objectives.
 Build organizational capability:  Support the development and adoption of frameworks, methodologies, tools, templates, and ways of working that strengthen technology strategy and architecture capabilities across the U.S. organization.
 Facilitate cross-functional collaboration:  Coordinate across business lines, technology teams, architecture, finance, risk, and other stakeholders to gather inputs, resolve issues, and support decisions on cross-cutting technology priorities.
 Identify emerging issues and opportunities:  Analyze trends across the technology estate and external technology landscape to identify potential capability gaps, duplication, architectural constraints, emerging technologies, and opportunities for strategic improvement.

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must have: 
 Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience in technology, business, engineering, finance, or a related field.
 10+ years of experience across technology strategy, enterprise architecture, technology transformation, management consulting, technology program management, or related disciplines.
 Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience structuring ambiguous problems and developing fact-based recommendations.
 Ability to understand complex technology environments and connect technology considerations to broader business and strategic objectives.
 Experience supporting technology strategies, roadmaps, business cases, investment decisions, operating models, or transformation initiatives.
 Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into clear presentations and decision materials.
 Strong stakeholder management skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively across business and technology organizations.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a complex, matrixed environment.
 Strong understanding of technology and/or the financial services industry.
 Experience using current AI tooling to support research, automate repetitive tasks, analyze large data sets, etc.

 Nice to have: 
 Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
 Experience in a matrix environment, such as a large, publicly traded corporation.

 What’s in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.
 Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
 A world-class training program in financial services.

jobs.title: Director, AI Delivery & Portfolio Management – Global Payments Technology
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 RBC's Global Payments Technology organization is modernizing international payments infrastructure across real-time payments, cross-border transactions, debit cards, ACH, and emerging payment channels. We're now scaling AI capabilities to enhance fraud detection, optimize payment routing, improve transaction monitoring, and drive operational efficiency across our global payments ecosystem.
 We're seeking an exceptional delivery leader to orchestrate multiple large AI programs within Global Payments Technology while establishing AI-native delivery practices that respect the security, compliance, and reliability demands of mission-critical payments systems.
 As Director, AI Delivery & Portfolio Management – Global Payments Technology, you will lead a strategic portfolio of AI initiatives across research, engineering, platform, and business teams. You will drive alignment across complex programs, champion modern AI delivery methodologies, and ensure program management evolves to embrace AI's iterative nature while maintaining stringent operational and regulatory standards.
 Reporting to the Senior Director, Program Delivery, you will own end-to-end delivery accountability for this strategic AI portfolio while establishing AI SDLC standards that shape how RBC delivers AI solutions for payments at scale.

 What will you do? 
 Program & Portfolio Leadership 
 Lead delivery on multiple concurrent AI initiatives focused on payments innovation (fraud detection, payment routing optimization, transaction monitoring, operational efficiency) with high complexity, uncertainty, and strategic value
 Manage portfolio-level roadmaps, dependencies, and resource allocation across payments-focused AI programs
 Own end-to-end delivery accountability from planning through production deployment and value realization for each initiative, ensuring seamless integration with RBC's global payments infrastructure
 Develop and maintain program roadmaps, milestones, dependency plans, and execution strategies aligned with business objectives and approved timelines, budgets, and scope
 Coordinate activities across AI Research, AI Solutions Engineering, platform teams, payments operations, governance partners, and business stakeholders across international payments, debit cards, ACH, RTR, and payment channel teams

 Payments Domain Expertise & AI SDLC Development 
 Maintain strong understanding of Global Payments Technology domain: international payments flows, debit card processing, ACH, Real-Time Payments (RTR/FedNow), SWIFT, cross-border settlement, and emerging payment channels
 Champion the evolution and operationalization of AI-native software development lifecycle practices tailored to payments systems, where reliability, security, and regulatory compliance are non-negotiable
 Establish standards and processes that reflect the unique characteristics of AI development in payments (model development, experimentation, data pipelines, validation, monitoring, fraud pattern evolution)
 Influence engineering teams and stakeholders toward adoption of modern AI delivery practices including continuous training, model governance, MLOps, production monitoring, and explainability requirements critical to payments
 Balance traditional delivery discipline with the iterative, experimental nature of AI development; advise teams on risk-based approaches to AI model validation and deployment in payments contexts
 Drive knowledge sharing across programs on AI SDLC best practices, payments-specific lessons learned, and regulatory considerations

 Cross-Functional Team Leadership 
 Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across diverse technical teams (data scientists, ML engineers, platform engineers, payments domain experts, infrastructure teams, and business partners)
 Build trusted relationships across business, engineering, platform, payments operations, compliance, and governance functions; serve as the primary delivery point of contact for senior stakeholders
 Lead large cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations within Global Payments Technology
 Coach delivery leads and team members on program management best practices tailored to AI initiatives in payments; share payments domain knowledge across delivery teams
 Work effectively with Global Payments business partners, payment network providers (networks, central banks, regulators), and third-party payment solution providers

 Delivery Execution & Governance 
 Establish effective governance processes including status reviews, risk management, issue resolution, and executive reporting that account for payments-specific compliance and operational requirements
 Monitor initiative health through delivery metrics, OKRs, KPIs, and operational dashboards; maintain performance visibility and accountability
 Identify and proactively resolve delivery bottlenecks, technical dependencies, organizational challenges, and AI-specific risks (model performance, data quality, fairness, regulatory compliance, payment accuracy, fraud evolution)
 Anticipate and quantify tactical, operational, and strategic risks specific to payments (transaction volume spikes, regulatory changes, network disruptions); apply risk-based approaches to forecasting and mitigation
 Manage program-level communications including status reports, executive updates, steering committee materials, and regulatory/compliance reporting as required
 Ensure delivery teams maintain rigorous quality assurance and testing standards appropriate to mission-critical payments systems

 Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management 
 Develop strong understanding of AI solution architecture for payments, data ecosystems, platform capabilities, and operational requirements supporting payments initiatives
 Partner with engineering leaders, architects, product teams, payments domain experts, data governance partners, and compliance teams to understand technical requirements, constraints, and delivery dependencies
 Translate technical AI concepts into clear business language and payments-specific business requirements into actionable delivery plans
 Balance business priorities, technical quality, delivery timelines, and payments-specific considerations (security, compliance, SLA requirements) when supporting implementation decisions
 Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication and proactive management of complex, high-pressure situations inherent in payments technology
 Ensure technical risks are identified, communicated, and mitigated throughout the delivery lifecycle, with particular attention to payments system stability and data security

 Resource, Risk & Financial Management 
 Manage initiative budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and vendor engagements across the payments AI portfolio
 Ensure effective utilization of resources while balancing delivery commitments and organizational priorities
 Track financial performance and value realization against approved business cases; drive ROI visibility and accountability
 Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks impacting timelines, scope, quality, or business outcomes, including payments-specific operational and regulatory risks
 Drive timely issue resolution and escalation management; facilitate decision-making to maintain delivery momentum while protecting payment system integrity

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must have: 
 10+ years of experience managing large and complex transformation programs or technology initiatives
 Strong understanding of payments domain (international payments, debit cards, ACH, RTR, cross-border settlement, or related payment channels) OR proven ability to quickly master complex domain requirements
 Strong understanding of AI/ML software delivery lifecycle, Agile methodologies, modern engineering practices
 Expert knowledge of program and project plan development & management, scheduling methodology, and program metrics/analysis
 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities with demonstrated ability to lead and influence large cross-functional teams across business and technology organizations
 Experience managing program-level budgets, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and executive communications

 Nice to have: 
 Demonstrated experience leading technology delivery in payments, financial services, or similarly regulated/mission-critical environments
 Background as a software engineer, data engineer, ML engineer, payments engineer, or distinguished engineer who transitioned into delivery leadership
 Experience driving cultural transformation and organizational change in payments or technology organizations
 Proven people management skills and ability to retain top technical talent

 What's in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses, flexible benefits, competitive compensation, and stock where applicable
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and mentoring opportunities
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact on how RBC delivers AI solutions for global payments at enterprise scale
 Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team at the forefront of AI innovation in payments technology
 World-class training and development programs in AI, financial services, payments systems, and leadership
 Flexible work/life balance options
 Opportunities to do challenging, meaningful work that shapes the future of global payments infrastructure

jobs.title: Head of Toronto AI Center
jobs.description:
Lab Summary: 

 Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

 Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

   The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

   Areas of Research: 

 Computer Vision

 Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling

 3D Perception & Scene Understanding

 Inference and Reasoning

 Machine and Deep Learning

 Human Computer Interaction (HCI)

 Natural Language Processing

 Position Summary: 

 Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

 The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap

 Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company

 Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams

 Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams

 Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,

 Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities

 Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships

 Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

   Required Skills: 

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

 10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.

 Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.

 Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence

 Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.

 Experience in publishing scientific papers in top quality conferences/journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.)

 Experience in DL library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc. with strong hands on experience is required

 Experience working with GPU, parallel programming, and Simulation environments is a plus

 Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus

 Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning

 Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment

 Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders

 Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills

 Additional Information 

 Disclosure of Trade Secrets 

 Samsung has a strict policy on trade secrets. In applying to Samsung and progressing through the recruitment process, you must not disclose any trade secrets of a current or previous employer.

 Essential Job Functions 

 This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

 Samsung Research America is committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws related to the employment of qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact the recruiter or email sratalent@samsung.com. 

 Equal Employment Opportunity 

 At Samsung, we believe that innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We aim to create a global team where everyone belongs and has equal opportunities, inspiring our talent to be their true selves. Together, we are building a better tomorrow for our customers, partners, and communities.

 Samsung Research America is committed to employing a diverse workforce, and  provide Equal Employment Opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you'll do 
 Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

 What you'll bring 
 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

 Even better... 
 Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful.
